props.name: tests on 46 samples from production charges gave the thermograms and synthesis properties
props.note: only 14 charges are reported individually
props.statement: Thermograms and synthesis properties were determined in tests on 46 samples from production charges; 14 charges are shown in Abb. 1 and the table.

props.name: thermographic testing solved the activity-control problems in production; valid only for the same preparation recipe
props.scope: catalysts made by the same recipe
props.statement: Thermographic testing of the catalysts quickly and well solved all problems of activity control in the author's works and has proved itself in production control; the relations hold only when the same recipes are used for the preparation.

props.name: nitrate up to 0.03 wt% NO3 is harmless and gives no exothermic effect
props.note: the tests behind this statement are not described
props.statement: According to the author's tests, contents up to 0.03 wt% NO3 are harmless and also show no exothermic effect in the thermogram.

props.name: charges without an exothermic peak were very active; exothermic peaks indicate preparation faults and inactive catalysts
props.statement: The unequal thermal effects indicate differences between charges: the charges without an exothermic peak were very active, exothermic effects show that the preparation procedure was not followed, and exothermic effects in the thermogram are a sign of inactive catalysts.

props.name: quality control previously relied on synthesis in test reactors (slow, costly); methanol decomposition at normal pressure only approximately related (cited)
props.note: cited from refs. 1-5 (Cryder and Frolich; Dohse; Frolich; Hüttig and Kostelitz; Huffman and Dodge)
props.statement: Quality control of methanol catalysts previously relied almost exclusively on synthesis in test reactors, which is very time-consuming and costly; judging activity by catalytic methanol decomposition at normal pressure is more advantageous, but only an approximate relation between formation and decomposition has been found for some catalysts.

props.name: morphological, chemical, physical and mechanical checks of charges gave no basis for judging activity
props.statement: Each production charge is checked for morphological, chemical, physical and mechanical properties, but these investigations gave no suitable basis for judging the activity of the catalysts.

props.name: some thermograms show only endothermic peaks at 150 °C and about 220 °C; others also an exothermic peak at about 280 °C
props.statement: The thermograms of the production charges differ: some curves have only endothermic peaks at 150 °C and about 220 °C, others additionally an exothermic peak at about 280 °C.

props.name: H2:CO = 4 synthesis gas
the exothermic reactions are probably due to decomposition of nitrate admixtures
props.statement: The exothermic reactions in the thermograms are probably due to the decomposition of nitrate admixtures.
